mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 3.0% indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing equity discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 3.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.1 percentage points signals labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.1pp in 1 month, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction permits (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicate broad demand contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate revenue expectations.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline in the last month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when HOUST and RSAFS both decline in the last month, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A manufacturing supply shock (INDPRO decline exceeding 1.0% over 3 months) reduces corporate margins through higher input costs, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO declines > 1.0% in 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising residential construction permit rate (HOUST) indicates housing market strength, boosting consumer confidence and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when HOUST is rising, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Accelerating inflation (CPIAUCSL exceeding 3.0% year-over-year) signals impending monetary tightening, reducing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when CPIAUCSL rises > 3.0% year-over-year, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in employment growth (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) indicate labor market slowdown, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when PAYEMS growth < 0.5% and UNRATE > 5.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% year-over-year), a rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS increase > 0.25pp in 1 month) signals aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL > 3.0% year-over-year and FEDFUNDS rises > 0.25pp in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.0% year-over-year and FEDFUNDS rises > 0.25pp in 1 month, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
